Fake base of products

Source: R/fake_products.R
fake_products.Rd

Fake base of products

Usage

fake_products(n, seed = 2811)

Arguments

n

Number of Products to generate

seed

the random seed, default is 2811

Value

a dataframe

A dataframe of fake products.

Examples

fake_products(10)
#> # A tibble: 10 × 8
